question: How long does standard delivery take?
answer: Standard delivery within the country takes 3 to 5 working days. Delivery to remote pin codes can add one extra day.

question: Do you offer express delivery?
answer: Yes. Express delivery is available in 350 cities and delivers within 1 to 2 working days. The option appears at checkout if your pin code is covered.

question: Do you ship outside India?
answer: We ship to 42 countries. International orders take 7 to 14 working days and customs duty is charged to the customer.

question: What is the return window for most products?
answer: Most products can be returned within 10 days of delivery. The item must be unused, with tags attached and the original invoice.

question: How do I start a return?
answer: Open Orders, select the item, and choose Return. Pick a reason, book a pickup slot, and print the return label if your order qualifies for self-ship.

question: Who pays the return shipping fee?
answer: We pay the return shipping when the item is damaged, defective, or wrong. For a change-of-mind return, a fee of 79 rupees is deducted from the refund.

question: When will I get my refund?
answer: Refunds are issued within 5 working days after the returned item reaches our warehouse. The bank then takes 3 to 7 working days to credit the amount.

question: How do I track the status of my refund?
answer: Open Orders and select View refund status. It shows the stage: pickup done, received at warehouse, refund processed, and credited.

question: Can I get a refund to a different bank account?
answer: No. Refunds return to the original payment method. If your card was replaced, ask your bank to map the refund to the new card.

question: Where is my order right now?
answer: Open Orders, select the order, and choose Track shipment. The map shows the last scan, the hub, and the expected delivery date.

question: Why is my order status not updating?
answer: Scan delays usually come from network gaps at transit hubs. The tracking page refreshes within 24 hours, and you can contact support after that.

question: Can I cancel an order after placing it?
answer: You can cancel any time before the order is shipped. Open the order and choose Cancel order. Once shipped, raise a return instead.

question: How do I cancel a single item from a multi-item order?
answer: Open the order, select the item, and choose Cancel item. The rest of the order ships as normal and the refund is issued to the payment method.

question: Why did my payment fail?
answer: Payments fail when the bank declines the transaction, the 3-D Secure step times out, or the daily card limit is reached. Nothing is debited; retry after 10 minutes.

question: Which payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept UPI, credit and debit cards, net banking, wallets, and cash on delivery. Cash on delivery is not available on orders above 20,000 rupees.

question: Do you offer cash on delivery?
answer: Yes, on orders up to 20,000 rupees. A handling fee of 25 rupees applies, and cash on delivery is not available for some pin codes.

question: Can I pay in instalments?
answer: No-cost instalments are available on cards from 7 banks for orders above 3,000 rupees. Choose the EMI option at checkout and pick a 3, 6, or 9 month plan.

question: How do I reset my password?
answer: Choose Forgot password on the sign-in screen, enter your email, and follow the reset link. The link is valid for 30 minutes.

question: I am not receiving the one-time password. What should I do?
answer: Check that your number has signal and that DND has not blocked the sender. If it still fails after 5 minutes, ask your carrier for the DND settings, or use email sign-in.

question: How do I delete my account?
answer: Open Settings, then Privacy, then Delete account. The account is closed after 30 days, and order records are kept for tax purposes for 8 years.

question: Can I change the delivery address after ordering?
answer: You can change the address before the order is dispatched. Open the order and choose Edit address. After dispatch, redirect the parcel with the courier or refuse it at the door.

question: Do you deliver to a pickup point?
answer: Yes. Choose a pickup point at checkout from 12,000 partner stores, and the parcel is held there for 3 days for collection.

question: Can I exchange an item for a different size?
answer: Yes, within 10 days of delivery, if the size is in stock. Choose Exchange at the return step, and the replacement ships after the pickup scan.

question: What if the replacement item is out of stock?
answer: You can wait until it is restocked or take the refund instead. The refund for an out-of-stock exchange is issued to the original payment method.

question: How do I apply a coupon code?
answer: Enter the code in the Coupons field on the payment page and choose Apply. One coupon applies per order, and it cannot be used after the order is placed.

question: Why was my coupon rejected?
answer: A coupon fails when the cart total is below the minimum, the code has expired, or the excluded items are in the cart. Check the terms shown under the code.

question: My item arrived damaged. What do I do?
answer: Raise a Damage claim within 48 hours of delivery with photos of the item and the package. We pick it up free of cost and refund or replace it.

question: How do I get a GST invoice?
answer: Add the GSTIN in Settings, then Billing details, before you place the order. The invoice is emailed after dispatch, and a copy is on the order page.

question: What personal data do you store?
answer: We store your name, contact details, addresses, and order history to deliver orders. You can request a copy of your data from Settings, then Privacy, then Download your data.

question: Do you share my data with sellers?
answer: Sellers see only what is needed to ship the item: the delivery address, the item, and a masked phone number. Your payment details are never shared.

question: Do all products come with a warranty?
answer: Most electronics carry a 1-year brand warranty and consumables carry none. The warranty period is listed on the product page under Specifications.

question: How do I claim a warranty?
answer: Raise a Warranty claim from the order page within the warranty period. Our service centre arranges a pickup and the brand decides repair or replacement.

question: Who pays shipping for a warranty pickup?
answer: We pay the shipping to the service centre and the return leg after repair. If a claim is rejected for misuse the shipping is charged back.

question: The brand declined my warranty claim. What now?
answer: Ask the brand for the inspection report and send it with your order number. We escalate to the seller for a repair or replacement decision within 7 working days.

question: Does the warranty cover accidental damage?
answer: No. Accidental and liquid damage are outside warranty. Accidental-protection plans can be bought at checkout for select products.

question: How do I register my product warranty?
answer: Registration is automatic when the invoice is in your account name. Where a brand asks for it, upload the invoice on the brand portal within 30 days.

question: Where are the service centres for my city?
answer: Open the product page and choose Service centres. The list shows brand-authorised centres with addresses and phone numbers.

question: What does the standard warranty cover?
answer: Manufacturing defects for the period shown on the product page. Wear from use, accidental damage, and liquid damage are not covered.

question: Is the warranty valid in another country?
answer: A local warranty does not travel. Buy the international-warranty version where the seller offers it; the product page says which ones carry it.

question: My warranty repair took too long. What can I do?
answer: If the repair is not closed in 21 days, ask the service centre for a job number and raise a Delay claim. We then push for a replacement or a refund.

question: What is the subscription plan for repeat orders?
answer: The subscription plan buys a product every 1, 2 or 3 months at 8 percent off. Choose the plan on the product page before checkout.

question: How do I skip a subscription delivery?
answer: Open Subscriptions, choose the upcoming delivery and pick Skip. Up to 3 deliveries a year can be skipped at no charge.

question: How do I cancel a subscription?
answer: Choose Cancel in Subscriptions at least 2 days before the next billing date. Cancelling does not refund the current delivery.

question: When is my subscription charged?
answer: Your card is charged 2 days before the delivery date. A failed charge retries twice before the subscription is paused.

question: Can I change the item in a subscription?
answer: Open Subscriptions, choose Change item and pick any item from the same plan list. The change applies from the next delivery.

question: Can I change the delivery date of a subscription?
answer: Yes, within the same month. A date in a later month counts as a skip and the delivery is placed as a fresh order.

question: Do subscription orders earn loyalty points?
answer: Yes, on the item value after the plan discount. Points from subscriptions are credited a week after delivery.

question: Is there a minimum number of subscription deliveries?
answer: No. There is no lock-in and the 8 percent discount applies to every delivery until you cancel.

question: How do I pause a subscription for a few months?
answer: Choose Pause and set the months. A pause of up to 3 months keeps the plan price; a longer pause cancels the plan.

question: Can I subscribe to more than one product?
answer: Yes. Each subscription has its own billing date and up to 10 active subscriptions are allowed on one account.

question: How do loyalty points work?
answer: You earn 1 point per 10 rupees on prepaid orders. 100 points convert to 10 rupees of store credit at checkout.

question: When do my loyalty points expire?
answer: Points expire 12 months after they are earned. The order page shows the expiry month for each block of points.

question: Why did my points not arrive?
answer: Points credit after the return window closes, so cancelled or returned items earn none. The balance updates within 24 hours of the window closing.

question: Which orders do not earn loyalty points?
answer: Cash-on-delivery orders, gift-card purchases and orders paid with store credit earn no points. Wallet top-ups earn none either.

question: How do I redeem loyalty points?
answer: Choose Use points at checkout and pick the amount. Points can cover up to 20 percent of the order value.

question: Can loyalty points be transferred?
answer: No. Points stay on the account that earned them and cannot be moved, sold or merged with another account.

question: How do loyalty tiers change my benefits?
answer: Silver earns points only, Gold adds free delivery and early access to sales, and Platinum adds a dedicated support line. The tier is set by points earned in a 12-month window.

question: Do loyalty points work on sale items?
answer: Yes, on the item value after the discount. Points are not earned on delivery charges or the handling fee.

question: How do I check my points history?
answer: Open Account, then Loyalty, then Points history. Each line shows the order, the points earned or spent and the expiry month.

question: I lost points to an expired balance. Can I get them back?
answer: No. Expired points are not restored. The Points history page shows the month each block expired.

question: How do I buy a gift card?
answer: Open Gift cards, pick a value from 100 to 10,000 rupees, add a message and pay. The card is emailed within 5 minutes and stored in your account.

question: How do I redeem a gift card?
answer: Enter the code in the Gift card field at checkout. The value is applied before any coupon and any balance stays on the card.

question: Does the gift card expire?
answer: A gift card is valid for 1 year from purchase. The expiry date is printed on the card and shown in your account.

question: Can I get a refund for a gift card?
answer: No. Gift cards are not refundable, not replaceable if lost and cannot be exchanged for cash.

question: Can I use more than one gift card?
answer: Yes, up to 3 gift cards on one order, and any unused balance stays on each card for later orders.

question: Do gift cards work on every product?
answer: They work on products we ship directly. Some seller-listed items and cash-on-delivery orders are excluded.

question: Can I reload a gift card?
answer: A gift card cannot be reloaded. Buy a new card with the value you want.

question: How do I send a gift card later?
answer: Choose Schedule at checkout and pick the date. A scheduled card is emailed on that date, up to 6 months ahead.

question: Can I book installation for a second product?
answer: Yes. Choose Installation on the second order and pick a slot. Two orders can share one visit if the address and the date are the same.

question: Can I track an order without signing in?
answer: Yes. Use the order code and the phone number given at checkout on the Track order page. Guest tracking stays open for 90 days after delivery.

question: Can someone else collect my pickup-point parcel?
answer: Yes. The order code and the phone number are enough, and the partner store keeps the parcel for 3 days before returning it.

question: Can I get support in a regional language?
answer: Yes. Chat offers English, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Bengali, and Marathi. The language is picked at the start of the chat.

question: Does the invoice show the serial number?
answer: Yes. Serial numbers of electronics are listed on the invoice, and a service centre asks for the invoice on a warranty claim.

question: Do you have bulk pricing?
answer: Bulk pricing starts at 10 units of the same item. Raise a Bulk quote from the product page and the seller replies within 2 working days.

question: How do I register as a business buyer?
answer: Choose Business account at signup and add the GSTIN and PAN. Approval takes 1 working day and prices then show without GST.

question: Do business orders get a GST invoice?
answer: Yes, once the GSTIN is on the account. The invoice shows the CGST and SGST split and is emailed after dispatch.

question: What is the credit limit for business accounts?
answer: Business accounts on 30-day credit start at 50,000 rupees. The limit rises after three settlements and is reviewed every quarter.

question: Can I order on 30-day credit?
answer: Yes, for approved business accounts. Open Credit terms in Settings, then Billing, and choose the sellers you want credit from.

question: Are bulk orders delivered in one shipment?
answer: Yes when the seller has the stock. A split shipment is shown on the order page before you pay and no extra charge applies.

question: How do I raise a bulk return?
answer: Raise a bulk return within 10 days with the job number. Pickup is booked for a fixed slot and can take 5 working days.

question: Do business orders earn loyalty points?
answer: No. Business-account orders earn no points and points cannot be bought or moved from a personal account.

question: Can I add team members to a business account?
answer: Yes, up to 25 users. Each has a separate login and can place orders on the account credit.

question: Where do I see all business invoices?
answer: Open Settings, then Billing, then Invoices. The export downloads a CSV with every invoice from the last 3 years.

question: How do I dispute a business invoice line?
answer: Choose Dispute on the invoice line and add the reason. The seller answers within 3 working days and the credit note is issued on the account.

question: What is store credit?
answer: Store credit is money on your account used at checkout before a card or UPI. It comes from refunds and loyalty conversion.

question: When does a refund become store credit?
answer: A refund becomes instant store credit when you pick it at the return step, or when the bank rejects the original transfer twice.

question: How do I check my store credit balance?
answer: Open Account, then Wallet. The balance, every credit and debit, and the expiry month are listed there.

question: Does store credit expire?
answer: Yes, 12 months after it is issued. The expiry date is shown on the Wallet page before you pay with it.

question: Can I withdraw store credit to my bank?
answer: No. Store credit can only be spent on orders and cannot be withdrawn or transferred.

question: Does store credit work with cash on delivery?
answer: Yes, but the order total after credit must be zero. A partial-credit order still needs a prepaid payment.

question: Can I collect my order from a store?
answer: Yes, choose Store pickup at checkout where the seller offers it. The parcel is kept for 3 days and the store is shown on the order page.

question: How will I know my pickup order is ready?
answer: You get an SMS and an app notification with the store code. The order page shows Ready to collect after the shelf scan.

question: What do I bring for a store pickup?
answer: Bring the pickup code from your account. Some categories ask for an ID that matches the name on the order.

question: Can someone else collect my order?
answer: Yes. Share the pickup code with them; for age-restricted items the collector must show their own ID.

question: How long can a store hold my parcel?
answer: 3 days from the Ready scan. After that the parcel returns to the seller and the order is refunded minus the shipping charge.

question: Who ships my order?
answer: Some items are shipped by us and some by the seller. The order page shows Ships from and Delivered by for every item.

question: How do I contact the seller?
answer: Open the order, choose Ask seller and send a message. Sellers answer within 24 hours and the thread stays on the order.

question: What if the seller does not respond?
answer: If there is no reply in 48 hours, choose Escalate on the order and support takes over the thread.

question: Can I follow a seller for new listings?
answer: Yes. Choose Follow on the seller page and their new listings appear under Following in Shop.

question: How do I report a listing that looks wrong?
answer: Choose Report listing on the product page and pick a reason. A review takes 2 working days and can end in a listing change or a seller warning.

question: Do seller prices include delivery?
answer: The product page shows the item price and the delivery charge separately. A free-delivery badge means no charge on that item.

question: Are sellers verified?
answer: Sellers are verified with a GSTIN and an address check. The product page shows the seller rating and the number of orders shipped.

question: Can a seller cancel my order?
answer: Yes, if the item is out of stock, and the reason is shown on the order. The payment is released to your bank in 1 working day.

question: Can I change my delivery slot after ordering?
answer: Before dispatch, yes. Open the order, choose Delivery slot, and pick another window. A 30-minute window still costs 49 rupees.

question: What happens if I am not home at delivery?
answer: The courier attempts a second delivery the next working day. After two failed attempts the parcel returns to the seller and the order is refunded.

question: Can I ask the courier to deliver to a neighbour?
answer: Yes, for orders below 5,000 rupees, by adding a note on the order page. The delivery is then recorded against your address.

question: Why is there a remote-area charge on my order?
answer: A charge of 60 rupees applies to pin codes the courier classifies as remote. It is shown before payment and is not refundable after dispatch.

question: What happens to delivery on a national holiday?
answer: No dispatch happens on national holidays. An order placed that day moves to the next working day and the expected date updates on its own.

question: Can I reschedule a delivery?
answer: Yes, until the parcel leaves the last hub. Choose Reschedule on the order page and pick a date within the next 7 days.

question: What does signature-on-delivery mean?
answer: The courier takes your signature at handover. It is applied automatically to orders above 15,000 rupees and cannot be switched off for them.

question: Is an ID needed at delivery?
answer: For age-restricted items such as alcohol-based products and laser pointers, the collector shows a government photo ID matching the order name.

question: How is a large parcel delivered?
answer: Parcels above 25 kg are delivered to the building door. For lifts, the courier waits 10 minutes; beyond that a second visit is booked.

question: Can I change the delivery address to another city?
answer: Not after the order is placed. Cancel the order before dispatch and place a new one; the refund reaches the original payment method.

question: How is my order packaged?
answer: Items are boxed with corrugated sheets and taped. Fragile items get an extra layer and a This side up label.

question: Can I ask for no plastic in the packaging?
answer: Yes. Choose Plastic-free packaging at checkout where the seller supports it, and the parcel uses paper tape and shredded filler.

question: Why is my parcel heavier than the item?
answer: The courier weight includes the box and filler. The invoice shows the item weight and the chargeable weight separately.

question: My parcel is lost in transit. What do I do?
answer: Raise a Lost parcel claim after 7 days of no scan. We refund the item value and the shipping charge to the original payment method.

question: The courier says delivered but I have nothing. What now?
answer: Ask the courier for the delivery photo through the Track page, then raise a Not-received claim. We check the proof of delivery and refund if it is wrong.

question: How long does a lost-parcel refund take?
answer: The refund is initiated within 2 working days of an approved claim and the bank takes 3 to 7 working days to credit it.

question: I received the wrong item. What do I do?
answer: Raise a Wrong item claim within 48 hours with a photo. We pick it up free of cost and ship the correct item or refund it.

question: A part is missing from my order. What do I do?
answer: Raise a Missing part claim with a photo of the parcel and the packing list. We ship the missing part or refund its value.

question: The colour looks different from the website. Why?
answer: Product photos are shot under studio light, so screen colours differ. A Wrong-item claim needs the item, not a colour difference, which is not covered.

question: How do I know a product is genuine?
answer: Products in the Assured program ship from verified sellers with brand invoices. Any product with a brand hologram is checked before dispatch.

question: I think my item is counterfeit. What do I do?
answer: Stop using it and raise a Counterfeit claim within 72 hours with photos. We collect the item, send it to the brand, and refund on confirmation.

question: Can I get an alert when an item is back in stock?
answer: Yes. Choose Notify me on the product page and we push a notification and an email when the seller restocks.

question: What does backorder mean?
answer: A backorder ships when the seller restocks, usually within 14 days. The product page shows the restock estimate before you pay.

question: Can I preorder an unreleased product?
answer: Yes, where the seller takes preorders. The charge is at order time and the release date is shown on the product page.

question: Is a limited drop first-come first-served?
answer: Yes. Drop stock is not reserved, and orders are filled in the sequence they are paid.

question: Will the price drop after I order?
answer: If the price drops within 7 days of your order, claim the difference under Price protection on the order page once per order.

question: Do you match prices with other websites?
answer: We match the listed price of an identical item on 4 partner sites within 7 days of purchase, up to 2,000 rupees per order.

question: A listing price looks like an error. What then?
answer: Obvious pricing errors are not honoured. The order is cancelled, the payment is released, and a 10 percent coupon is issued for the trouble.

question: Is GST included in the listed price?
answer: Yes, listed prices include GST for items below 2,000 rupees, and the invoice shows the tax split.

question: Do prices change after I add an item to the cart?
answer: A price can change while an item sits in the cart. The charge is the price shown on the payment page when you pay.

question: What grade are refurbished items?
answer: Refurbished items are graded A, B or C by visible wear. The grade, the tests run, and the 6-month warranty are on the product page.

question: Do open-box items come with a full warranty?
answer: Open-box items carry a 6-month seller warranty and a 7-day return window. Full warranty items are marked as new only.

question: Can I return a refurbished item?
answer: Yes, within 7 days of delivery, if it is unused with its accessories. The return fee is waived for defects.

question: Do you install what you sell?
answer: Installation is offered by the seller for appliances in 60 cities. Choose Add installation at checkout and a technician visits within 3 days.

question: What does a paid installation cover?
answer: It covers unpacking, fitting, a demo of the basic functions, and taking away the packaging. It does not cover carpentry or electrical work.

question: Can I schedule installation for a later date?
answer: Yes, up to 30 days after delivery. Choose Reschedule visit on the order page and pick a slot the installer offers.

question: The technician did not come. What do I do?
answer: Raise a Visit-not-done claim on the installation order. A new slot is booked within 48 hours or the installation fee is refunded.

question: How do I turn on two-factor sign-in?
answer: Open Settings, then Security, then Two-step verification, and pick SMS or an authenticator app. Backup codes are shown once for account recovery.

question: Why was my account locked?
answer: An account locks after 5 failed sign-in attempts or a sign-in from a new device in a new city. Unlock it with the email link, valid for 15 minutes.

question: How do I sign out of all devices?
answer: Open Settings, then Security, then Sign out everywhere. Every session ends, and the current device asks for the password again.

question: Someone used my account. What should I do?
answer: Change the password, turn on two-step verification, and check Orders for anything you did not place. Raise a Fraud claim and we refund an unauthorised order.

question: Do you ever ask for my password or OTP?
answer: No. We never ask for a password, an OTP, or a card number on a call, a chat, or an email. Anyone asking is not us.

question: How do I stop marketing messages?
answer: Open Settings, then Notifications, and switch off Marketing. Service messages about your orders still arrive, as they are required.

question: Can I turn off push notifications?
answer: Yes, per category in Settings, then Notifications. Delivery reminders stay on until the order is delivered, then stop.

question: I get too many WhatsApp messages. What can I do?
answer: Switch off WhatsApp updates in Settings, then Notifications. Order updates then arrive by email and in the app only.

question: How do I chat with support?
answer: Open Help, then Chat with us. The queue shows a median wait of 4 minutes, and the chat stays on your order for 24 hours.

question: What are support hours?
answer: Chat runs 8 am to midnight every day. Email support answers within 24 hours, and calls on orders above 20,000 rupees run till 10 pm.

question: How do I complain about a support answer?
answer: Rate the chat as unhelpful, then choose Escalate with a note. The complaint reaches a team lead and gets a written reply in 3 working days.

question: Is support available in my language?
answer: Chat is in English and Hindi. The help centre pages are in 8 languages, and you can switch under Help, then Language.

question: Can I get a tax invoice for my order?
answer: Yes, from the order page, choose Invoice, then Tax invoice. It is emailed and stored for 8 years for tax purposes.

question: Is customs duty included in international orders?
answer: No. Customs duty and import charges are billed separately by the carrier and are the buyer's responsibility on international orders.

question: Do I pay tax on delivery charges?
answer: Yes. GST of 18 percent applies to the delivery charge, and the invoice shows it as a separate line.

question: Which app versions do you support?
answer: The app supports Android 9 and above and iOS 15 and above. Older versions stop receiving security updates and sign-in is blocked.

question: The app crashes when I open orders. What do I do?
answer: Clear the app cache in Settings, then Apps, then Shop, then Storage. If it still crashes, reinstall and keep the same phone number.

question: Can I use the website and the app together?
answer: Yes. Both share one account, one cart, and one order history. A cart added on the website appears in the app after a refresh.

question: Is the app usable with a screen reader?
answer: Yes. Labels, roles, and focus order are set for TalkBack and VoiceOver, and the contrast meets the AA standard on both.

question: How do I leave a review?
answer: Open the order, choose the item, then Write a review. Only delivered orders can be reviewed, and a review can be edited for 30 days.

question: Why was my review removed?
answer: A review is removed when it has a phone number, a link, abusive language, or a claim about a different order. The reason is emailed.

question: Do reviews from my account count for a rating?
answer: Yes, one review per purchase counts. Reviews from accounts with no order on that item are kept but excluded from the average.

question: How do I download all my data?
answer: Open Settings, then Privacy, then Download your data. A link with your orders, addresses, and chats is emailed within 7 days.

question: Do you sell my data to advertisers?
answer: No. We do not sell personal data. Ad partners receive only a hashed device identifier for measurement, which you can switch off.

question: How long do you keep order records?
answer: Order and invoice records are kept for 8 years as tax law requires. Account preferences and browsing data are deleted in 12 months.

question: Can I choose which sellers see my address?
answer: Only the seller shipping an item to you sees that address, with a masked phone number. There is no per-seller switch, because delivery needs the address.

question: Why is my order split into two shipments?
answer: Items from different sellers or warehouses ship separately. Both shipments are shown on the order page with their own tracking links.

question: Can I merge two orders into one delivery?
answer: Yes, within 30 minutes of the second order, on orders from the same warehouse. Choose Merge shipments on the newer order and the fee difference is refunded.

question: Can I add an item to a placed order?
answer: Not to a placed order. Place a second order and use Merge shipments where both items ship from the same warehouse.

question: Why is my order on hold?
answer: An order holds when a payment check, a high-value verification, or a risk review runs. The hold clears within 24 hours and the order page shows it.

question: How do I reorder something I bought before?
answer: Open Orders, choose the order, then Buy it again. The same item and address are filled in and you only confirm payment.

question: Can I create a wishlist to buy later?
answer: Yes. Choose the heart icon on a product page. A wishlist is private, holds 200 items, and shows a price-drop alert.

question: Do you have a waitlist for sold-out sizes?
answer: Yes. Choose Notify me on the size and we alert you when that size is restocked. Waitlist alerts are one per product.

question: Is my card saved on your site?
answer: Only with your consent, and then only as a token from the payment gateway. The full card number is never stored on our servers.

question: How do I remove a saved card?
answer: Open Settings, then Payment methods, choose the card, then Remove. A removed card returns only by a new consent at checkout.

question: Why was I charged twice?
answer: A duplicate charge happens when a bank posts the same transaction twice. Raise a Duplicate-charge claim and the extra amount is refunded in 5 working days.

question: My money was debited but the order failed. What now?
answer: A failed order releases the hold in 24 hours, and the bank credits it in 3 to 7 working days. Nothing needs to be paid again if the amount shows as on hold.

question: Can I split one payment across two cards?
answer: No. A second card is not accepted on the same order. Store credit and loyalty points can be used along with the single card or UPI payment.

question: Do you accept international cards?
answer: Yes, where the gateway allows them. An international card may add a cross-border fee from your bank, which we do not control.

question: What is the UPI limit per order?
answer: UPI payments are capped at 1,00,000 rupees per transaction by UPI rules. Larger orders need net banking or a card.

question: Can I pay on delivery with UPI?
answer: Yes, in 90 cities. Choose UPI on delivery and the courier shows a QR at your door.

question: Is cash-on-delivery available everywhere?
answer: No. It is unavailable for some pin codes, gift cards, and orders above 20,000 rupees. The checkout shows whether it is available.

question: Do you store my UPI ID?
answer: No. A UPI payment is collected by the gateway, and we keep only the transaction code for the invoice.

question: What is the no-cost EMI minimum?
answer: No-cost EMI needs an order above 3,000 rupees on a card from one of the 7 participating banks. Interest is borne by the seller, not by you.

question: Can I foreclose an EMI order?
answer: Yes, from the bank portal or by calling the bank. The foreclosure charge is set by the bank and is not collected by us.

question: Why did my EMI get declined?
answer: An EMI is declined when the card limit is short, the bank does not allow that category, or the tenure is not offered. The bank message tells which.

question: Can I cancel an order that is packed but not shipped?
answer: Yes, until the dispatch scan. After the scan the order must be refused at the door, and the refund follows the return path.

question: Do I get a cancellation fee for changing my mind?
answer: No cancellation fee. The delivery charge is refunded when the order never left the warehouse.

question: How long does an order cancellation refund take?
answer: The refund is initiated within 24 hours of a cancellation and the bank credits it in 3 to 7 working days.

question: Can I cancel a cash-on-delivery order after refusing it?
answer: A refused parcel is cancelled at the first scan back to the seller. No charge is raised, and the order shows as refused.

question: Can I exchange an item for a different colour?
answer: Yes, within 10 days, if that colour is in stock. Choose Exchange at the return step and pick the colour you want.

question: How do I exchange a gift I received?
answer: The receiver can exchange it with the order number from the invoice. The item ships to the receiver, and the exchange follows the same rules.

question: Can I exchange a sale item?
answer: Clearance items marked Final sale cannot be exchanged or returned. Regular sale items follow the 10-day exchange window.

question: Do I pay again for an exchange if the price differs?
answer: If the new item costs more, pay the difference at pickup booking. If it costs less, the difference is refunded to the original payment method.

question: Can I exchange a personalised item?
answer: No. Engraved or made-to-order items are final sale and cannot be exchanged, except when they arrive damaged.

question: Can I return an item without its packaging?
answer: Yes, for a 10-day change-of-mind return, but the refund is reduced by 10 percent when the original box is missing.

question: Which items cannot be returned?
answer: Intimate wear, perishables, opened software, and items marked Final sale cannot be returned. The product page marks them clearly.

question: How do I self-ship a return?
answer: Choose Self-ship at the return step, print the label, and drop the parcel at the listed courier point within 7 days. Keep the drop receipt.

question: What if my return parcel is damaged in transit?
answer: Pack the item as received; a return damaged by poor packing is rejected by the warehouse and the refund is withheld.

question: When is a return refund issued after a pickup?
answer: The refund is issued within 5 working days of the warehouse receiving the item. The bank then takes 3 to 7 working days.

question: Can I cancel a return I raised?
answer: Yes, before the pickup scan. After the scan the return runs and the refund goes to the original payment method.

question: Do I get a refund for the return fee?
answer: The 79-rupee change-of-mind fee is not refunded. It is waived when the item is damaged, defective, or wrong.

question: Can I split a refund across methods?
answer: No. A refund returns to the original payment method in full, including any delivery charge that was refundable.

question: Why is my refund smaller than what I paid?
answer: A refund deducts the return fee, the shipping paid on the original order, and any price difference from an exchange. The refund page itemises it.

question: How do I check whether a refund was credited?
answer: Open Orders, then View refund status, and check the Credited stage and date. The bank reference is shown next to it.

question: What does the last scan on my tracking page mean?
answer: The last scan is the most recent hub event. A parcel can sit at that hub for up to 24 hours before the next outbound scan.

question: Can I get a delivery SMS in my own language?
answer: Yes. Set the language under Settings, then Notifications. Delivery SMS then arrive in that language where the courier supports it.

question: My tracking link does not open. What is wrong?
answer: Links are valid for 30 days from dispatch. After that, open Orders and choose Track shipment to get a fresh link.

question: Can I track a return pickup?
answer: Yes. Open the return, then Track pickup. It shows the assigned courier, the pickup scan, and the warehouse in-scan.

question: Do heavy items carry a delivery surcharge?
answer: Yes. Items above 25 kg or half a cubic metre carry a surcharge of 150 rupees, which is shown at checkout before you pay.

question: How is the delivery charge calculated?
answer: It is based on item weight, distance, and delivery speed. The exact charge is shown on the payment page before you pay.

question: Are delivery charges refunded when I return an item?
answer: The original delivery charge is refunded only when the item was damaged, defective, or wrong. A change-of-mind return keeps it.

question: Can I split one order across two addresses?
answer: Not within one order. Place two orders with two addresses; each then has its own delivery charge.

question: Can I deliver to a friend's address?
answer: Yes. Add the address at checkout. The parcel is handed over against an OTP sent to your number, so share the code with the receiver.

question: What is the cutoff for same-day delivery?
answer: Same-day delivery needs the order before 1 pm in a covered pin code. Orders after that move to the next working day.

question: Do you ship cold-chain items like ice cream?
answer: Yes, to 12 cities with dry-ice packs. A cold-chain parcel must be accepted at the door; a refused parcel is not refunded.

question: How do I ship a perishable item back?
answer: Perishables are not returnable after delivery except when spoiled on arrival. Raise a Spoiled claim within 24 hours with photos.

question: How do bank offers work?
answer: A bank offer gives an instant discount on a card or UPI at checkout. The discount shows as a line on the payment page before you pay.

question: Why did my bank discount not apply?
answer: A bank offer needs a minimum order, a card from that bank, and often a specific tenure. The offer card lists the terms.

question: Can I use a coupon with a bank offer?
answer: Yes, one coupon per order plus one bank offer. The coupon applies to the item value and the bank discount applies to the total.

question: Do you run student or referral offers?
answer: Students get 5 percent off after verification, and a referral gives both accounts 100 rupees of store credit after the first order.

question: What happens to a coupon if my order is cancelled?
answer: A coupon used on a cancelled order returns to your account with its original expiry, once the refund is initiated.

question: Are coupons valid during a sale?
answer: Most coupons work with sale prices, but a coupon used on an already-discounted item may not stack on clearance prices.

question: How do I get a restock or waitlist alert faster?
answer: Turn on push notifications for the product. An alert then arrives on the app within a minute of the seller restocking.

question: Can I have two accounts with the same phone number?
answer: No. One account per phone number. To move your history, add the number as a contact on the new account and we merge on request.

question: How do I change the email on my account?
answer: Open Settings, then Profile, then Email. A confirmation link goes to both the old and the new address, valid for 24 hours.

question: How do I close my account temporarily?
answer: Choose Deactivate in Settings, then Privacy. The profile hides, your orders stay, and signing in again reactivates it.

question: What happens to my wallet balance if I delete the account?
answer: A store credit balance is refunded to the original payment method before deletion, once, and gift cards are then void.

question: Can I keep my order history after deleting the account?
answer: Order and invoice records stay for 8 years for tax law, but they are detached from your profile and not visible to you.

question: How long does a password reset link last?
answer: 30 minutes, and it works once. Ask for a new link if it expired.

question: Why do I get an OTP on every sign-in?
answer: Sign-ins from a new device, a new city, or after 30 days ask for an OTP. A trusted device is remembered for that price.

question: My item leaked in the box. What do I do?
answer: Raise a Damage claim within 48 hours with photos of the item and the leaked parcel. We pick it up free of cost and refund or replace it.

question: Can I keep a damaged item and get a part refund?
answer: Yes, for minor cosmetic damage on a working item. The claim page offers a partial refund between 10 and 30 percent.

question: Where do I find old invoices?
answer: Open Orders, choose the order, then Invoice. Invoices from the last 8 years are downloadable as PDF.

question: Can I change the GSTIN on an issued invoice?
answer: Yes, within 30 days. Request the change on the invoice page and a revised invoice is issued with the same number and a revision note.

question: The invoice shows a wrong address. How do I fix it?
answer: Raise an Invoice correction on the order page within 30 days of dispatch. The revised invoice is emailed and the old one is voided.

question: Who can see my reviews and profile name?
answer: Your display name and reviews are public. Your address, phone number, and order details are never shown.

question: Can I delete a single order from history?
answer: No. The history is kept for tax law. Hiding an order from the app hides it for you only and not for the record.

question: Do you use my data for recommendations?
answer: Yes, orders and browsing on the platform feed recommendations. You can reset that history under Settings, then Privacy, then Reset interests.

question: How do I object to automated decisions?
answer: Write to the grievance officer from Settings, then Privacy, then Contact. A human reviews the decision within 15 days.

question: How do I add money to my wallet?
answer: Open Account, then Wallet, then Add money, and pay by UPI or card. A top-up needs a minimum of 100 rupees and earns no loyalty points.

question: My wallet top-up failed but money left my account. What now?
answer: A failed top-up reverses in 24 hours, and the bank credits it in 3 to 7 working days. Raise a Failed-payment claim with the transaction code if it does not.

question: Can I combine store credit with a card?
answer: Yes. Store credit is applied first and the remaining amount goes to one card or UPI payment. Two cards on one order is not supported.

question: Can I combine a gift card with store credit?
answer: Yes. Store credit is applied first, then the gift card, then the remaining amount to a card or UPI.

question: Do points earned on my old phone number still work?
answer: Yes, if the accounts are merged. Raise a Merge accounts request from Settings, then Support, and the points move with the older account.

question: Can a subscription deliver to a gift address?
answer: No. A subscription follows the account address. Change the account address and the next delivery follows it.

question: Do subscription refunds follow the same timeline?
answer: Yes. A cancelled subscription refunds within 5 working days of a decision, and the bank takes 3 to 7 more.

question: Can a buyer pay a bulk order by bank transfer?
answer: Yes, for orders above 50,000 rupees on credit terms. The transfer details are on the invoice, and dispatch follows the credit.

question: Do bulk orders have a return window?
answer: Yes, 10 days, with pickup booked at a fixed slot. A single wrong unit is replaced and the rest is not returned.

question: What happens if a seller ships a fake item?
answer: The listing is removed, the seller is suspended, and the buyer is refunded. Reports go to the brand with the invoice of the item.

question: Can a seller see my order history?
answer: No. A seller sees only the orders that include their items, with the delivery address and a masked phone number.

question: Can the courier hand the parcel to a family member?
answer: Yes, to any adult at the address who can give the OTP. The delivery photo and the receiver name stay on the tracking page.

question: What is a contactless delivery?
answer: The courier leaves the parcel at your door, takes a photo, and sends it to you. It is offered where the pin code allows it.

question: Can I tip the courier in the app?
answer: Yes, a tip of 20, 50 or 100 rupees after delivery. The full amount goes to the courier and we add nothing.

question: Do you take back the packaging on the next visit?
answer: Yes, a courier can take corrugated boxes and filler on a delivery visit. Choose Packaging pickup on the order page to ask for it.

question: Can I get an insurance claim on a lost parcel?
answer: Orders above 10,000 rupees are insured by default. An approved claim pays the item value, and the claim is raised on the order page.

question: I got a used item instead of a new one. What do I do?
answer: Raise a Wrong-item claim within 48 hours with photos of the item and seals. We collect it and ship a new one or refund it.

question: How do I cancel a waitlist alert?
answer: Open the product page and choose Notify me again to switch it off. Alerts also stop when the product is delisted.

question: Do gift cards get price protection?
answer: No. Price protection covers item purchases and not gift cards, wallet top-ups, or subscription plan charges.

question: Is the delivery fee part of price protection?
answer: No. Only the item value is compared. A later delivery-fee change is not covered.

question: Can I gift my loyalty points to another account?
answer: No. Points stay on the account that earned them and cannot be transferred or gifted to another account.

question: Is installation free on appliances?
answer: It is free on 1,200 listed appliances and paid on the rest. The product page shows Installation free or the fee at checkout.

question: How do I report a phishing email that uses our name?
answer: Forward it to the report address in Settings, then Security, then Report phishing, then delete it. Do not click any link in it.

question: Can I get an email digest instead of every alert?
answer: Yes. Choose Daily digest under Settings, then Notifications. Alerts then arrive once a day at 8 pm.

question: Can I email support with a document attached?
answer: Yes, up to 3 files of 10 MB each. Larger files are rejected by the mail gateway, so split them.

question: How do I reopen a closed chat?
answer: A closed chat cannot be reopened. Start a new chat and quote the old case number, which stays on the order for 24 hours.

question: Is my order taxed by the state where I live?
answer: Yes. GST is charged at the rate for the delivery state, and the invoice shows the CGST and SGST or IGST split.

question: Can I use the app without an account?
answer: You can browse and search without an account. An order, a cart, and a wishlist need an account.

question: Can I reply to a review of my product?
answer: No. A buyer can edit their review for 30 days, but a seller reply is not supported.

question: Do you keep chat transcripts after a case closes?
answer: Chats are kept for 24 months for dispute handling, then deleted. A closed case can be reopened by quoting the case number.

question: Can I get a copy of an order by email?
answer: Yes. Choose Email order copy on the order page, and it is sent to the account email as a PDF.

question: What does a partial refund on my order mean?
answer: A partial refund covers one item of a multi-item order, or a claim on part of an order. The rest of the order is untouched.

question: Can I order on behalf of a company with my personal account?
answer: You can, but the invoice then is a consumer invoice. A tax invoice needs a business account with a GSTIN.

question: How do I get a payment receipt?
answer: A receipt is attached to the invoice on the order page. Choose Download receipt for the payment gateway reference.

question: Do you accept digital wallets?
answer: Yes, PayZapp, Mobikwik, and Amazon Pay. Wallet balances need a minimum of 50 rupees at checkout.

question: What if my bank charges a failed-payment fee?
answer: We do not collect a failed-payment fee. Any charge from your bank is between you and the bank.

question: Can I cancel only the delivery and pick it up later?
answer: No. An order is either delivered or cancelled. Store pickup is chosen at checkout, not after.

question: How do I exchange an item bought in a sale?
answer: A sale item follows the 10-day window unless marked Final sale. Choose Exchange at the return step and pick the size you want.

question: Can I return a gift card purchase?
answer: No. A gift card is not refundable and the buyer of the card cannot claim it back.

question: Can I ask for a refund in cash?
answer: No. Refunds go back to the payment method or, with your choice, to store credit.

question: Two of my three parcels arrived. Where is the third?
answer: Each parcel has its own tracking link on the order page. The missing one is either at a hub or delayed by a courier backlog.

question: Can I deliver to a locker point?
answer: Yes, in 6 cities for orders below 5,000 rupees. Choose Locker pickup at checkout and use the code sent at delivery.

question: How long is a locker parcel held?
answer: 48 hours. After that the parcel is returned to the seller and the order is refunded.

question: Can a coupon be refunded if unused?
answer: A coupon is not bought here, so nothing is refunded. An unused coupon simply stays in your account until it expires.

question: Can I change my display name?
answer: Yes, once every 90 days, under Settings, then Profile. Reviews keep the name used at the time.

question: The outer box is crushed but the item works. What do I do?
answer: A damage claim needs a fault. If the item works, no claim is due, and a cosmetic box issue is not covered.

question: Can I get one invoice for two orders?
answer: No, one invoice per order. A merged shipment still keeps two invoices, one per order.

question: Is my browsing data shared with the seller?
answer: Only an aggregate count of views per product. Your individual browsing is not shared with sellers.

question: Does a replaced item get a fresh warranty?
answer: Yes. A replacement under warranty gets a new warranty from the date it is delivered, not from the original order date.

question: Can a subscription price change?
answer: A subscription price follows the listed price. A change is emailed 7 days before the next billing date.

question: Are points earned on a bulk quote order?
answer: No. Bulk quote orders are business orders and earn no loyalty points.

question: Can a gift card be used in the app?
answer: Yes, in the Gift card field at checkout, the same as on the website.

question: Can I change the pickup store after ordering?
answer: Not after dispatch. Ask the current store to redirect the parcel, or refuse it and reorder from the store you want.

question: Can store credit pay a cash-on-delivery order?
answer: Only if the credit covers the full order. Otherwise the order must be prepaid.

question: How many quotes can I request at once?
answer: One quote per product and quantity, up to 20 products in a single request. Each is answered by its own seller.

question: Can I buy from the same seller across orders?
answer: Yes. There is no limit, and the seller rating and shipping speed stay shown on their listings.

question: Do you deliver to army or campus addresses?
answer: Yes, with a 1 to 2 extra day for gate clearance. A campus address needs a room or block number in the address line.

question: A parcel was left with a security guard. What do I do?
answer: Check the delivery photo on the tracking page. If it shows a guard handover, raise a Not-received claim with the guard's name.

question: Two items were swapped in my parcel. What do I do?
answer: Raise a Wrong-item claim within 48 hours with a photo of both items. We collect the wrong items and ship the right ones.

question: Can I reserve stock in my cart?
answer: No. A cart does not reserve stock. A sold-out item at payment time must be reordered when the seller restocks.
